title: Senate findings that UAP records were wrongly classified and withheld

tellings.quote: So the Senate is basically saying in their findings that they believe credible evidence indicates that relevant UAP records have been inappropriately classified and withheld from appropriate, you know, elected officials in both the legislative and executive branch.

plain: The US Senate found that records about UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer term for UFOs, had been wrongly classified and kept from elected officials. The researcher Matthew Pines reads this in the findings of the UAP Disclosure Act, an amendment by Senators Schumer and Rounds to the yearly defense bill, put forward in the Senate on 13 July 2023, saying they state that "credible evidence indicates that relevant UAP records have been inappropriately classified and withheld" from officials in both Congress and the executive branch. As Pines gives it, this is an unusually direct statement, which would mean the Senate itself believes UFO information was hidden from those meant to oversee it.
